description: Data-shape profile of the BC case entity sets (bc_read.CASE_ENTITY_SETS) in every company the adapters read (by index, never by name), lines of the first 5 documents of each document set, and number/vendor/customer/item joins per company.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it. Publishes the profile inline, or as results/profiles/<id>.json (one file per spec, overwritten each run; the check carries profile_file and counts) when run with --output results/... or --profiles-dir (plx-data-profile/v1, rebuilt by verify.data_profile.sanitize_profile): names, counts, null/absence rates, type and string-class counts, distinct-count and length buckets, AAA-9999 shape masks of single-token code values (a digit, no whitespace, no @) shared by >= 5 rows, nested JSON key names only when reviewed (verify/profile-nested-keys.json) or source-declared (other keys as counted shape masks), declared column names only (other row keys counted), declared key uniqueness and join resolution rates. Never values, names, emails, amounts, subjects, file names or ids. A non-zero errors_count fails the check but the partial profile is still published. BC Production, GET only (BusinessCentralReader). BC numbers are decimal text in reader output. Samples are 200 records per set (complete=false when BC holds more), so most join rates are lower bounds; posted receipts/invoices whose order was fully received/invoiced no longer have a purchaseOrders row in BC, so a low receipt->order rate is expected, not a defect.
